description: This file defines service functions for interacting with a task management backend via Supabase. It includes functions to fetch board data, create and update tasks and columns, and move tasks between columns.

methods.name: fetchBoard
methods.description: Fetches board columns, tasks, and members from the database, returning empty arrays if Supabase is not configured.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Creates a new task in the database via RPC, with provided partial task data.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by ID with provided changes via RPC.

methods.name: moveTask
methods.description: Moves a task to a different column and position by updating its column and position fields via RPC.

methods.name: createColumn
methods.description: Creates a new column at a specified position.

methods.name: updateColumn
methods.description: Updates a column's data by its ID.
